scene_type: 2D (per inputs.json) - but mild perspective is visible, see notes.md
units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale

camera.motion: static: phase correlation of the sky/tree region vs frame 0 shifts <= 0.02 px in all 55 frames
camera.view: side view at roughly car height, perpendicular to the car's path; principal point assumed at image centre (540, 540)
camera.perspective_cues: car's front face visible when it is at the left edge and rear face at the right edge; far-side tyres peek out ~35 px from the near-side tyres when |x-540| ~ 415-440 px => far side / near side depth ratio ~1.09. Bridge deck top edge is a horizontal line at y ~539-540 (car path line). Horizon hidden by hills.
camera.apparent_size_change: car silhouette height constant 125-129 px; full-car silhouette length 421-430 px (frames 13-36, slightly larger near the left edge, from perspective); wheel radius constant ~33.5 px; hub y constant 505.5 => constant depth

car.description: red/maroon classic sports coupe (Porsche 911 Turbo-like, rear spoiler), seen from its right/near side, driving left to right on top of the bridge
car.visible_frames: 0-52 (partial 0-12 entering at left edge, fully in view 13-36, partial 37-52 leaving at right edge; not visible 53-54)
car.reference_point: axle_mid_x/axle_y = midpoint of the two near-side wheel hubs (vehicle root proxy). bodycentre_x_est = axle_mid_x - 10.5 (silhouette bbox centre). centreplane_x_est = parallax-corrected to the car's centre depth (k = 0.957, estimate).
car.width_px: not visible (pure side view); far-side tyres offset ~35 px by parallax only
car.motion: straight horizontal, +x (left to right), uniform: near-side axle midpoint linear in frame with 28.227 px/frame slope, rms residual 0.65 px, quadratic term 0.0025 px/frame^2 (negligible); y constant
car.occlusion: never occluded; it passes IN FRONT of the bare tree trunk (frames ~20-35) and the big tree trunk (frames ~36-52)

bridge.description: rusty steel/concrete beam bridge spanning the whole frame width, the car drives on its deck
bridge.notes: cut by both image edges; small brackets under the deck every ~150 px (x ~40, 190, 340, 490, 635, 785, 935)

big_tree.description: large leafy green tree at right

bare_tree.description: thin, sparsely leaved tree in the middle behind the bridge

rock_hill.description: reddish-brown rocky hill at left background

grass_hills.description: green grassy slopes in background centre/right

stream.description: water channel under the bridge, animated ripples; shows a faint reflection of the car

log_rocks_in_water.description: mossy log/rocks in the stream right of centre

branch_in_water.description: small dead branch at left bank

grass_banks.description: dry grass banks left (x 0-260) and right (x 740-1080) below the bridge

events.event: clip starts with the car already moving; front bumper at x=96, front wheel hub just off-screen
car first fully in view (rear bumper x=6)
car at image centre (axle midpoint crosses x=540 at frame ~24.4)
last frame fully in view (front bumper x=1054)
front bumper reaches the right image edge
last visible frame (rear bumper sliver x>=1047)
no start/stop, no braking, no direction change, no bounce or contact events (wheels in contact with deck throughout)

files.tracks/car.csv: per-frame car reference points, hubs, bbox, silhouette sizes
files.scripts/: all measurement scripts (bg.py, track_car.py, refine_car.py, wheels.py, build_track.py, static.py, check_overlay.py) and bg.png (clean background)
